units: Targ. Job XIX, 23 (Ms. פיטקא; h. text ספר). Targ. II Esth. I, 8 כסא … שמיה פ׳ a large goblet … which was named Pithḳa (Decree, v. פּוּסְקָא).—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:8:11">Y. Sot. I, 17ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>כתוב חד פיתק דתרין וכ׳</he> write out one edict (order) for two men whom I may take with me; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 73b:1">Kidd. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>תלי פ׳</he> if the infant wears a tablet (with an inscription).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 3:3:19">Y. Bicc. III, 65ᵈ</cite> <he>אוף</he> … <he>הוי בפ׳</he> R. J. was likewise on the list (of those to be appointed).
<cite ref="Horayot 13b:16">Hor. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>הוו כתבי קושייתא בפ׳ וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>בפסקא</he>) wrote out questions on a tablet and threw them into the school-house.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 70a:13">Kidd. 70ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="E00301"><he>הַזְמָנָא</he></cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Chullin 31a:3">Ḥull. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>דכולה פתקא</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01525"><he>פִּקְתָא</he></cite>.]—Pl. <cite ref="Q00713"><he>פִּיתְקִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q00905"><he>פִּתְ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91">Gen. R. s. 91</cite> <he>והוה … ומקבל פ׳</he> and Manasseh stood there (at the gates) receiving the tablets (with the names of the arrivals, v. <cite ref="Q00904">preced.</cite>).
